people.name: Ashkelon
people.line: A major Philistine city, often a target of prophecy.

translations.web: “How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.”
translations.bsb: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? He has appointed it against Ashkelon and the shore of its coastland.”

translations.asv: How canst thou be quiet, seeing Jehovah hath given thee a charge? Against Ashkelon, and against the sea-shore, there hath he appointed it.
